// This Pine Script™ code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// Assembled by ©ClassicScott

//@version=6
indicator(title = '+ ATR Support and Resistance', shorttitle = '+ ATR S/R', overlay = true, max_lines_count = 500)

//----- General inputs related to determining impulsive candles
period = input.int(title = 'ATR Period', defval = 14, minval = 1, group = 'General Inputs')
mult = input.float(title = 'ATR Multiple', defval = 1.55, step = 0.05, group = 'General Inputs', tooltip = 'Set this to determine the multiple by which an impulsive candle is calculated. A higher value will naturally return fewer candles')

atrMult = ta.atr(period) * mult
atr = ta.atr(period)

imp = ta.tr >= atrMult and ta.tr[1] <= atr[1]
impUp = ta.tr >= atrMult and close > open and ta.tr[1] <= atr[1]
impDown = ta.tr >= atrMult and close < open and ta.tr[1] <= atr[1]


//----- Line terminus for impulse close lines and RSI s/r lines
lineTerminus = input.int(defval = 10, title = 'Line Length', group = 'General Inputs', tooltip = 'The number of bars ATR close lines and RSI S/R lines extend from their origin candles.')


//----- Wick percentages maths - what percent of the candle does the wick take up?
impDownWick = if impDown
    high - open
impUpWick = if impUp
    open - low
impDownWickPercent = impDownWick / ta.tr
impUpWickPercent = impUpWick / ta.tr

totalPercentInput = input.int(defval = 25, minval = 0, maxval = 100, title = 'Wick %', group = 'General Inputs', tooltip = 'Defines the maximum percentage size of the wick of an impulsive candle (as defined by its ATR multiplier) that a box will be drawn from. Sometimes candles with big ATRs have huge wicks (and sometimes result in a candle that is not impulsive at all, but is something like a doji), and you, the person who has to look at your chart, doesn\'t want a giant box drawn across it. Adjusting this number will prevent that. For example, if you set the Wick % to 25 then any wicks that take up more than 25% of that candle will not have a box drawn. Set it to 100 to draw boxes from all wicks.')
totalPercentCalc = totalPercentInput * .01
totalPercent = 1 - totalPercentCalc

wickPercentDown = impDownWickPercent <= totalPercentCalc ? true : false
wickPercentUp = impUpWickPercent <= totalPercentCalc ? true : false


//----- Calculations and inputs for support and resistance zones -----\\
//----- Impulses up
upStyle = input.string(defval = 'Dotted', options = ['Solid', 'Dotted', 'Dashed'], title = 'Border Style', group = 'Support Zones')
upWidth = input.int(defval = 1, maxval = 4, title = 'Border Width', group = 'Support Zones')
upColor = input.color(color.new(#445b84, 20), title = 'Border Color', group = 'Support Zones')
upFill = input.color(color.new(#445b84, 70), title = 'Fill Color', group = 'Support Zones')

upLeft = impUp ? bar_index : na
upTop = impUp ? low : na
upRight = impUp ? bar_index : na
upBottom = impUp ? open : na
upBorderStyle = upStyle == 'Solid' ? line.style_solid : upStyle == 'Dotted' ? line.style_dotted : upStyle == 'Dashed' ? line.style_dashed : na

var upBox = array.new_box()
var upBoxLow = array.new_float()

if wickPercentUp
    array.push(upBoxLow, upBottom)
    array.push(upBox, box.new(upLeft, upTop, upRight, upBottom, xloc = xloc.bar_index, border_color = upColor, border_style = upBorderStyle, border_width = upWidth, bgcolor = upFill))

// Extend box then check for price break to terminate box
if (array.size(upBox) > 0)
    for i = 0 to array.size(upBox) - 1
        activeBox = array.get(upBox, i)
        activeBox.set_right(bar_index)

if (array.size(upBoxLow) > 0)
    for i = array.size(upBoxLow) - 1 to 0
        boxLowPrice = array.get(upBoxLow, i)
        if (close < boxLowPrice)
            brokenBox = array.get(upBox, i)
            brokenBox.set_right(bar_index)
            array.remove(upBoxLow, i)
            array.remove(upBox, i)
            

//----- Impulses down
downStyle = input.string(defval = 'Dotted', options = ['Solid', 'Dotted', 'Dashed'], title = 'Border Style', group = 'Resistance Zones')
downWidth = input.int(defval = 1, maxval = 4, title = 'Border Width', group = 'Resistance Zones')
downColor = input.color(color.new(#844444, 20), title = 'Border Color', group = 'Resistance Zones')
downFill = input.color(color.new(#844444, 70), title = 'Fill Color', group = 'Resistance Zones')

downLeft = impDown ? bar_index : na
downTop = impDown ? high : na
downRight = impDown ? bar_index : na
downBottom = impDown ? open : na
downBorderStyle = downStyle == 'Solid' ? line.style_solid : downStyle == 'Dotted' ? line.style_dotted : downStyle == 'Dashed' ? line.style_dashed : na
 
var downBox = array.new_box()
var downBoxHigh = array.new_float()

if wickPercentDown
    array.push(downBoxHigh, downTop)
    array.push(downBox, box.new(downLeft, downTop, downRight, downBottom, xloc = xloc.bar_index, border_color = downColor, border_style = downBorderStyle, border_width = downWidth, bgcolor = downFill))

// Extend box then check for price break to terminate box
if (array.size(downBox) > 0)
    for i = 0 to array.size(downBox) - 1
        activeBox = array.get(downBox, i)
        activeBox.set_right(bar_index)

if (array.size(downBoxHigh) > 0)
    for i = array.size(downBoxHigh) - 1 to 0
        boxHighPrice = array.get(downBoxHigh, i)
        if (close > boxHighPrice)
            brokenBox = array.get(downBox, i)
            brokenBox.set_right(bar_index)
            array.remove(downBoxHigh, i)
            array.remove(downBox, i)


//----- Mid lines
midLineInput = input.bool(title = 'Display Lines', defval = true, group = 'Mid Lines', tooltip = 'Select this if you want to display the mid line of impulsive candles.')
midLineMeasureInput = input.string(title = 'Mid Line Range Selection', defval = 'Wicks', options = ['Wicks', 'Body'], group = 'Mid Lines', tooltip = 'Choose the price range that you would like the mid line to be determined by in impulsive candles.')
midStyle = input.string(defval = 'Solid', options = ['Solid', 'Dotted', 'Dashed'], title = 'Line Style', group = 'Mid Lines')
midWidth = input.int(defval = 1, maxval = 4, title = 'Line Width', group = 'Mid Lines')
midColor = input.color(color.new(#000000, 0), title = 'Line Color', group = 'Mid Lines')

//----- Determining the mid line of an impulsive candle
wicks = midLineInput ? (high + low) / 2 : na
bodies = midLineInput ? (open + close) / 2 : na
midLinePrice = midLineMeasureInput == 'Wicks' ? wicks : midLineMeasureInput == 'Body' ? bodies : na

//----- Drawing the lines
//----- Impulse up candles
midUpx1 = impUp ? bar_index : na
midUpy1 = impUp ? midLinePrice : na
midUpx2 = impUp ? bar_index : na
midUpy2 = impUp ? midLinePrice : na
midLineStyle = midStyle == 'Solid' ? line.style_solid : midStyle == 'Dotted' ? line.style_dotted : midStyle == 'Dashed' ? line.style_dashed : na
 
var midUpLine = array.new_line()
var midUpLinePriceArray = array.new_float()

if midLineInput and wickPercentUp
    array.push(midUpLinePriceArray, midLinePrice)
    array.push(midUpLine, line.new(midUpx1, midUpy1, midUpx2, midUpy2, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = midColor, style = midLineStyle, width = midWidth))

// Extend line then check for price break to terminate line
if (array.size(midUpLine) > 0)
    for i = 0 to array.size(midUpLine) - 1
        activeLine = array.get(midUpLine, i)
        activeLine.set_x2(bar_index)

if (array.size(midUpLinePriceArray) > 0)
    for i = array.size(midUpLinePriceArray) - 1 to 0
        upLinePrice = array.get(midUpLinePriceArray, i)
        if (close < upLinePrice)
            brokenUpLine = array.get(midUpLine, i)
            brokenUpLine.set_x2(bar_index)
            array.remove(midUpLinePriceArray, i)
            array.remove(midUpLine, i)

//----- Impulse down candles
midDownx1 = impDown ? bar_index : na
midDowny1 = impDown ? midLinePrice : na
midDownx2 = impDown ? bar_index : na
midDowny2 = impDown ? midLinePrice : na
 
var midDownLine = array.new_line()
var midDownLinePriceArray = array.new_float()

if midLineInput and wickPercentDown
    array.push(midDownLinePriceArray, midLinePrice)
    array.push(midDownLine, line.new(midDownx1, midDowny1, midDownx2, midDowny2, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = midColor, style = midLineStyle, width = midWidth))

// Extend line then check for price break to terminate line
if (array.size(midDownLine) > 0)
    for i = 0 to array.size(midDownLine) - 1
        activeLine = array.get(midDownLine, i)
        activeLine.set_x2(bar_index)

if (array.size(midDownLinePriceArray) > 0)
    for i = array.size(midDownLinePriceArray) - 1 to 0
        downLinePrice = array.get(midDownLinePriceArray, i)
        if (close > downLinePrice)
            brokenDownLine = array.get(midDownLine, i)
            brokenDownLine.set_x2(bar_index)
            array.remove(midDownLinePriceArray, i)
            array.remove(midDownLine, i)


//----- Impulse close lines
closesInput = input.bool(defval = false, title = 'Display Lines', group = 'Close Lines')
closesStyle = input.string(defval = 'Dotted', options = ['Solid', 'Dotted', 'Dashed'], title = 'Line Style', group = 'Close Lines')
closesWidth = input.int(defval = 1, maxval = 4, title = 'Line Width', group = 'Close Lines')
closesColor = input.color(color.white, title = 'Line Color', group = 'Close Lines')

closesx1 = imp ? bar_index : na
closesy1 = imp ? close : na
closesx2 = imp ? bar_index + lineTerminus : na
closesy2 = imp ? closesy1 : na
closesLineStyle = closesStyle == 'Solid' ? line.style_solid : closesStyle == 'Dotted' ? line.style_dotted : closesStyle == 'Dashed' ? line.style_dashed : na

if closesInput
    line.new(closesx1, closesy1, closesx2, closesy2, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = closesColor, style = closesLineStyle, width = closesWidth)



//----- Everything RSI -----\\
//----- Inputs
rsiPeriod = input.int(defval = 14, title = 'Period', group = 'RSI Inputs')
rsiOB = input.int(defval = 70, title = 'Overbought Level', group = 'RSI Inputs', tooltip = 'Determines the level at which the RSI is considered "overbought." If the RSI reaches or exceeds this level shapes are plotted across the top of the price chart.')
rsiOS = input.int(defval = 30, title = 'Oversold Level', group = 'RSI Inputs', tooltip = 'Determines the level at which the RSI is considered "oversold." If the RSI reaches or exceeds this level shapes are plotted across the top of the price chart.')
rsiLevelTop = input.float(defval = 52, title = 'Mid Zone Top', step = 0.1, group = 'RSI Inputs', tooltip = 'Set this as the top of the zone around the mid line of the RSI. This zone, based on price behavior is what is used to determine support or resistance.')
rsiLevelBottom = input.float(defval = 48, title = 'Mid Zone Bottom', step = 0.1, group = 'RSI Inputs', tooltip = 'Set this as the bottom of the zone around the mid line of the RSI. This zone, based on price behavior is what is used to determine support or resistance.')

//----- Function
up = ta.rma(math.max(ta.change(close), 0), rsiPeriod)
down = ta.rma(-math.min(ta.change(close), 0), rsiPeriod)
rsi = down == 0 ? 100 : up == 0 ? 0 : 100 - 100 / (1 + up / down)

//----- Mid zone
rsiSR = rsi >= rsiLevelBottom and rsi <= rsiLevelTop
rsiSupport = close < open and rsiSR
rsiResistance = close > open and rsiSR


//----- Support
rsiSupportInput = input.bool(defval = false, title = '', group = 'RSI Support Lines')
rsiSupportStyle = input.string(defval = 'Solid', options = ['Solid', 'Dotted', 'Dashed'], title = 'Line Style', group = 'RSI Support Lines')
rsiSupportWidth = input.int(defval = 1, maxval = 4, title = 'Line Width', group = 'RSI Support Lines')
rsiSupportColor = input.color(color.new(#0045ff, 0), title = 'Line Color', group = 'RSI Support Lines')

rsiSupportx1 = rsiSupport ? bar_index : na
rsiSupporty1 = rsiSupport ? close : na
rsiSupportx2 = rsiSupport ? bar_index + lineTerminus : na
rsiSupporty2 = rsiSupport ? rsiSupporty1 : na
rsiSupportLineStyle = rsiSupportStyle == 'Solid' ? line.style_solid : rsiSupportStyle == 'Dotted' ? line.style_dotted : rsiSupportStyle == 'Dashed' ? line.style_dashed : na

if rsiSupportInput and not rsiSR[1]
    line.new(rsiSupportx1, rsiSupporty1, rsiSupportx2, rsiSupporty2, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = rsiSupportColor, style = rsiSupportLineStyle, width = rsiSupportWidth)


//----- Resistance
rsiResistanceInput = input.bool(defval = false, title = '', group = 'RSI Resistance Lines')
rsiResistanceStyle = input.string(defval = 'Solid', options = ['Solid', 'Dotted', 'Dashed'], title = 'Line Style', group = 'RSI Resistance Lines')
rsiReistanceWidth = input.int(defval = 1, maxval = 4, title = 'Line Width', group = 'RSI Resistance Lines')
rsiResistanceColor = input.color(color.new(#ff0000, 0), title = 'Line Color', group = 'RSI Resistance Lines')

rsiResistancex1 = rsiResistance ? bar_index : na
rsiResistancey1 = rsiResistance ? close : na
rsiResistancex2 = rsiResistance ? bar_index + lineTerminus : na
rsiResistancey2 = rsiResistance ? rsiResistancey1 : na
rsiResistanceLineStyle = rsiResistanceStyle == 'Solid' ? line.style_solid : rsiResistanceStyle == 'Dotted' ? line.style_dotted : rsiResistanceStyle == 'Dashed' ? line.style_dashed : na

if rsiResistanceInput and not rsiSR[1]
    line.new(rsiResistancex1, rsiResistancey1, rsiResistancex2, rsiResistancey2, xloc = xloc.bar_index, color = rsiResistanceColor, style = rsiResistanceLineStyle, width = rsiReistanceWidth)


//----- Impulse bar coloring and shapes
barcolor(impUp ? #445b84 : impDown ? #844444 : na, title = 'Impulse Candles')

plotshape(impUp, title = 'Impulse Up', style = shape.circle, location = location.belowbar, color = color.new(#445b84, 0), display = display.none)
plotshape(impDown, title = 'Impulse Down', style = shape.circle, location = location.abovebar, color = color.new(#844444, 0), display = display.none)


//----- RSI bar coloring and shapes
barcolor(rsiSR and close > open ? color.new(#ff0000, 0) : rsiSR and open > close ? color.new(#0045ff, 0) : na, title = 'RSI S/R Candles', display = display.none)

plotshape(rsiSR and close < open, title = 'RSI Mid Line Support', style = shape.square, location = location.belowbar, color = color.new(#0045ff, 0), display = display.none)
plotshape(rsiSR and close > open, title = 'RSI Mid Line Resistance', style = shape.square, location = location.abovebar, color = color.new(#ff0000, 0), display = display.none)

plotshape(rsi >= rsiOB, title = 'RSI Overbought', style = shape.triangledown, location = location.top, color = color.new(color.yellow, 50))
plotshape(rsi <= rsiOS, title = 'RSI Oversold', style = shape.triangleup, location = location.top, color = color.new(color.purple, 50))


//----- High volume bar coloring and shapes
volumeOnOff = input.bool(title = '', defval = false, group = 'Volume Candle Color')
volumePeriod = input.int(title = 'EMA Period', defval = 21, group = 'Volume Candle Color', tooltip = 'EMA used to determine increasing or decreasing volume. Part of the formula for determining which candles have strong volume.')
volumeEMA = ta.ema(volume, volumePeriod)

highVolume = volume > volumeEMA and volume > volume[1]

barcolor(volumeOnOff and highVolume and volume > volume[1] and close < close[1] ? color.new(#ef9a9a, 0) : volumeOnOff and highVolume and volume > volume[1] and close > close[1] ? color.new(#90bff9, 0) : na, title = 'High Volume Candles')

plotshape(highVolume and close < open[1] and high >= high[1], title = 'Ran Previous High', style = shape.circle, location = location.abovebar, color = color.new(#ef9a9a, 0), display = display.none)
plotshape(highVolume and close > open[1] and low <= low[1], title = 'Ran Previous Low', style = shape.circle, location = location.belowbar, color = color.new(#90bff9, 0), display = display.none)


//----- OBV bar coloring
obvOnOff = input.bool(title = '', defval = false, group = 'OBV Candle Color')
obvPeriod = input.int(title = 'EMA Period', defval = 21, minval = 1, group = 'OBV Candle Color', tooltip = 'An EMA with its source as the OBV. Determines bar color.')
obvEMA = ta.ema(ta.obv, obvPeriod)

barcolor(obvOnOff and ta.obv > obvEMA ? color.new(#448484, 0) : obvOnOff and ta.obv < obvEMA ? color.new(#5a4484, 0) : na, title = 'OBV Bar Color')


//----- EMA + SMA + Kijun average
showMA = input.bool(title = '', defval = false, group = 'Moving Average', tooltip = 'Blend of SMA, EMA, and Kijun moving averages.')
maPeriod = input.int(title = 'Period', defval = 200, group = 'Moving Average' )

kijun = math.avg(ta.lowest(maPeriod), ta.highest(maPeriod))

maAvgs = (ta.ema(open, maPeriod) + ta.sma(open, maPeriod) + kijun) / 3

maColor = maAvgs > maAvgs[1] ? color.new(#445b84, 50) : color.new(#844444, 50)

plot(showMA ? maAvgs : na, color = maColor, title = 'Moving Average')
